info.name: Users API
info.description: Flujo repetible para la API de usuarios. Ejecutar en orden con el entorno Local.

exec: const suffix = `${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000)}`;
pm.environment.set('runSuffix', suffix);
pm.environment.set('userName', `Postman User ${suffix}`);
pm.environment.set('userEmail', `postman-${suffix}@example.test`);
pm.environment.set('updatedUserName', `Updated User ${suffix}`);
pm.environment.set('otherUserName', `Other User ${suffix}`);
pm.environment.set('otherUserEmail', `other-postman-${suffix}@example.test`);
pm.environment.set('skillName', `Postman Skill ${suffix}`);
pm.environment.set('postTitle', `Post ${suffix}`);
pm.test('returns 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('returns the created user without relations', function () { pm.expect(body).to.include({ name: pm.environment.get('userName'), email: pm.environment.get('userEmail') }); pm.expect(body.profile).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.skills).to.eql([]); });
pm.environment.set('userId', body.id);
pm.test('returns 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('returns the second unique user', function () { pm.expect(body).to.include({ name: pm.environment.get('otherUserName'), email: pm.environment.get('otherUserEmail') }); });
pm.environment.set('otherUserId', body.id);
pm.test('returns 400 for a missing email', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('returns a validation error body', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("'email' must be a non-empty string"); });
pm.test('returns 409 for a duplicate email', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('returns the duplicate-email error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Email is already registered'); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns the requested user', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('userId'))); pm.expect(body.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('userEmail')); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('includes the created user', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(function (user) { return user.id === Number(pm.environment.get('userId')); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('updates only the supplied name', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.name).to.eql(pm.environment.get('updatedUserName')); pm.expect(body.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('userEmail')); });
pm.test('returns 409 for an email used by another user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('returns the duplicate-email error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Email is already registered'); });
pm.test('returns 400 for an empty update', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('returns the update validation error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('At least one updatable field is required'); });
pm.test('returns 404 for an unknown user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the user-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('User not found'); });
pm.test('returns 400 for a missing bio', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('returns the profile validation error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("'bio' must be a non-empty string"); });
pm.test('returns 404 for an unknown user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the user-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('User not found'); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns a profile linked to the user', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.include({ bio: 'Created by Postman', user_id: Number(pm.environment.get('userId')) }); pm.environment.set('profileId', body.id); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('updates the existing profile', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.include({ id: Number(pm.environment.get('profileId')), bio: 'Updated by Postman' }); });
pm.test('returns 404 for an unknown user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the user-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('User not found'); });
pm.test('returns 404 for an unknown user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the user-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('User not found'); });
pm.test('returns 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('returns the created skill', function () { pm.expect(body.name).to.eql(pm.environment.get('skillName')); });
pm.environment.set('skillId', body.id);
pm.test('returns 400 for a blank name', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('returns a validation error body', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("'name' must be a non-empty string"); });
pm.test('returns 409 for a duplicate skill name', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('returns the duplicate-skill error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Skill name already exists'); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns the requested skill', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.include({ id: Number(pm.environment.get('skillId')), name: pm.environment.get('skillName') }); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('includes the created skill', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(function (skill) { return skill.id === Number(pm.environment.get('skillId')); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('returns 404 for an unknown skill', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the skill-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Skill not found'); });
pm.test('returns 404 for an unknown user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the user-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('User not found'); });
pm.test('returns 404 for an unknown skill', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the skill-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Skill not found'); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns the user with the assigned skill', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.skills).to.deep.include({ id: Number(pm.environment.get('skillId')), name: pm.environment.get('skillName') }); });
pm.test('returns 409 for an existing assignment', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('returns the assignment-conflict error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Skill is already assigned to user'); });
pm.test('returns 204 No Content', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test('returns no response body', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(''); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('does not include the removed skill', function () { const skills = pm.response.json().skills; pm.expect(skills.some(function (skill) { return skill.id === Number(pm.environment.get('skillId')); })).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('returns 404 for a removed assignment', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the assignment-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Skill assignment not found'); });
pm.test('returns 404 for an unknown assignment', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('returns the assignment-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Skill assignment not found'); });
pm.test('returns 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('returns the post linked to the user', function () { pm.expect(body).to.include({ title: pm.environment.get('postTitle'), content: 'Post body', user_id: Number(pm.environment.get('userId')) }); });
pm.environment.set('postId', body.id);
pm.test('returns 400 for a missing content', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('returns a validation error body', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("'content' must be a non-empty string"); });

pm.test('returns the user-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('User not found'); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('returns the requested post', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('postId'))); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('includes the created post', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(function (post) { return post.id === Number(pm.environment.get('postId')); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('updates only the supplied content', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.content).to.eql('Updated post body'); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql(pm.environment.get('postTitle')); });
pm.test('returns 400 for an empty update', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('returns the update validation error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('At least one updatable field is required'); });

pm.test('returns the post-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Post not found'); });

pm.test('returns the post-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Post not found'); });

pm.test('returns the post-not-found error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Post not found'); });

pm.test('returns no response body', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(''); });
